header: Classes overlap and are never summed; each class is compared separately against the same class. Limits (same semantics on every tree): a register redefined from itself plus a constant within one iteration counts as variant (invariant_load undercount); a pointer in a descriptor field the loop rewrites counts as invariant (invariant_load overcount; the rewrite is an alias_store). Dynamic counts are static counts times source trip products per role chain: a nested copy of an ancestor's source loop is not multiplied again; sibling copies of one source loop at one nesting position (versioned or peeled copies) are combined per parent iteration strictly: the baseline takes the minimum over the copies, a candidate the maximum (false failures only; a failing key may be refined only by recorded CFG ownership: guard-matched alternatives or sequential copies partitioning one trip); entry-level counts execute once per call. Loop roles: every machine loop's source loop comes from its control evidence (latch, entry, induction) and every assignment satisfying the search-independent invariants (evidence, embedding, no skipped level, no missing multi-trip loop) is enumerated; several valid assignments are combined by the side's rule (baseline minimum, candidate maximum) and disable static dominance; a nested copy of an ancestor's source loop is not re-multiplied on the candidate side only when its own latch names that header directly in a non-alternative assignment. Each loop records its provenance. Reproduction: from a 63b053401 checkout in the pinned image, CPUNativeTileStackBaseline.py per envelope (records, not committed), then this tool with --expect.
